title: Migrate raw SQL calls while preserving parameters
goal: Replace obsolete raw SQL entry points while retaining separate value parameters and cancellation.

selectionNotes: EF10 FromSqlInterpolated/ExecuteSqlInterpolated/ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync remain working parameterized APIs; EF11 marks them obsolete in favor of FromSql/ExecuteSql/ExecuteSqlAsync, which already exist in EF10. Keep an inline interpolation or FormattableString; assigning to string before a Raw call loses parameterization. Parameters represent values, not identifiers or arbitrary SQL syntax. Use fixed/allowlisted identifiers. Real SQLite query/update commands keep a quote/semicolon/comment-bearing label out of command text and inside parameters; fresh reads confirm two rows and no canceled write. Already-canceled async query/update throw OperationCanceledException; this does not prove interruption of a running database command. A fixed authored OR 1=1 negative control demonstrates changed predicate semantics without building SQL from untrusted input. Compile-only controls observe EF1002 interpolation on both versions and EF1003 Format/Concat recognition only on EF11, plus new CS0618 warnings. Diagnostics are neither sanitizers nor a comprehensive security analysis.

packageAssets: Exact independently locked SQL Server/SQLite graphs; Current supported route: .NET/SDK11, C#15 and matching EF11 packages. Measured SDK11.0.100, EF11.0.0 versus SDK10.0.403, C#14, runtime10.0.14 and EF10.0.13. Stable API shapes on RC2 are not GA proof. EF11/Core/Relational select net11.0; direct Sqlite11 selects net10.0. EF10 selects net10.0 and direct Sqlite10 net8.0. SQL Server provider uses SqlClient6.1.7 versus7.1.0; locked graphs pin Pkcs10.0.13. Windows x64 native SQLite3.53.3/SQLitePCLRaw2.1.13 versus3.53.4/3.0.5. Both native hashes/source IDs are recorded. No older-runtime EF11 route, new .NET10 foundation, encryption, other OS/provider, Cosmos transaction or GA claim. No workload, rendering mode or experimental opt-in applies.

prerequisites: PowerShell7, both pinned SDKs, running approved local SQL2025 Docker route and NuGet restore. Use eng/Test-AlderQueries.ps1; it injects credentials only in the child environment. Never print credentials. Copy the complete independent projects. Restore before offline execution.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API shape in GA-targeted guidance, measured on RC2 packages and SDK. No experimental API suppression required. Actual GA reconciliation remains outstanding.

evidence.scope: Run eng/Test-AlderQueries.ps1 -Record with the approved SQL2025 Docker route. It compiles both independent locked graphs, records fresh input hashes/dependencies/SDK/runtime, creates unique restricted databases, runs real SQL and native SQLite checks, and removes owned databases/logins in finally. behavior.evidence.json retains SQL, parameter values, runtime checks and compile-only diagnostics. verification-evidence.json retains compilation. Never execute DiagnosticProbe: it deliberately contains insecure compiler controls. Actual installed offline stdio inspection separately verifies discovery, full canonical body, target11/edition11, applicability and evidence. Unusable retrieval proxies prove proxy independence, not OS network isolation. PIN-959/PIN-965 and existing Human gates remain open.
